What is not run, and why: - No smoke entry: no boot-path file changes. The harness boot stamps at the default set 2.1.287, which this chunk does   not move. - No release check: `viola-e2e` is test-only and already refused by `scripts/release-check.sh`, and the product graph   is unchanged. - No mutation run (directive item 9; testing.md 2026-10-04).

Waits and kills: - The new rehearsals wait on the rig's exit through the file's existing `finished` / `run` helpers, under the   integration profile's kill. - The rig's own `--deadline` bounds every live start under its entry's `timeout`. - No new test sleeps to synchronise (tests S3).
Test homes: every rehearsal runs under its case's own dirs; the live starts under the rig's private scratch at `/tmp/viola-rig-<uid>/`, which names no `home` component.
The live legs' non-priming probes are the round entries ahead of them: the install read by path, the rig's census, and the build with its hashes. None primes anything.

**The remove-the-guard control** is implement's one-shot `gate.py control`, not an entry (validation.md check 4 (6)). - **Id and case:** `bt-absent` (C11), in `crates/viola-agent-claude/src/ledger.rs`. The edit removes the text   ` || (row == LedgerRow::BrowserToolsPrompt && word == "absent")` from `counts`. The case is   `ledger::tests::stamps::verified_reads_the_browser_tools_row_absent_as_counting`, named as nextest prints the NAME   (testing.md 2026-11-14). - **Firing:** on entry 3 with `--timeout 600`. That entry carries `--no-fail-fast`, so the named case runs whatever   its neighbours do. The earlier reading stopped at 448/650 under fail-fast   (`chunks/2026-11-18-browser-tools-prompt-modal/evidence/control-1.txt`). - **Reading:** «holds» only when that named case ran and FAILED with no TIMEOUT line. A `timeout` reading is not   «holds», nor is an entry merely red.
